[00:09:40] Q: How long have you been on equipment?
A: Eleven years. Two in the shop starting out, nine
in the field since. Dozers, excavators, wheel loaders,
some ag equipment.

[00:22:15] A: I rebuild final drives and hydrostatic
pumps. Learned it in the apprenticeship and never
stopped doing it.

[00:41:03] Q: Have you run a crew?
A: Two techs plus me, through one rebuild season.
Not a big crew. I was the one signing the work off.
